question: Why did the voice from heaven say, "Come out of her, my people"?
options: So that they would not share in her sins or receive her plagues
So that they could build a new city
So that they could fight against her
So that they could become merchants
explanation: The voice said, "Come out of her, my people, so that you will not share in her sins, so that you will not receive any of her plagues."
